bugs.title: Live Binance + Polymarket API integration had not been verified end-to-end
bugs.description: The initial build had no recorded live network verification.
bugs.evidence: LIVE-DATA-001 run #18: Binance PASS, Polymarket Gamma PASS, Polymarket CLOB PASS; health artifact retained by GitHub Actions.
bugs.verification: GitHub Actions LIVE-DATA-001 completed successfully after the Binance public market-data fallback was added.

bugs.title: Daily Polymarket resolution rules were not automatically verified against live market text
bugs.description: Scoring must verify source, pair, interval, metric, closing time and boundary convention from the day's market rules.
bugs.evidence: LIVE-DATA-001 run #18 matched Binance, BTC/USDT, 1m, Close, closing at 12:00 ET and higher-bracket exact-boundary rule.
bugs.verification: Live Gamma rules signature returned PASS.
bugs.next_action: Keep refusing official scoring if future market rules do not match.

bugs.title: Europe/Sofia ↔ America/New_York DST edge cases lacked verification
bugs.description: US/EU DST transition windows can shift the Sofia clock conversion by one hour.
bugs.evidence: CI run #25 passed explicit winter, summer, spring-mismatch and fall-mismatch timezone vectors. LIVE-DATA-001 run #18 mapped 12:00 ET to 19:00 Sofia on 2026-10-07 and replayed the prior day's exact Binance candle.
bugs.verification: 18/18 unit tests PASS plus historical 1m timestamp replay PASS.
bugs.next_action: Retain IANA timezone conversion; never hardcode +7 hours.

bugs.title: Hit-price forecasts are generated but hit-price scoring is not yet persisted
bugs.description: BUILD-001 can estimate hit probabilities, but score.json currently focuses on daily range scoring.
bugs.next_action: Implement high/low-based hit resolution and Brier scoring before HIT PAPER tests are counted.

bugs.title: Gemini context fallback needs full failure-path verification
bugs.description: Gemini is non-authoritative for the numerical forecast. Missing-key behavior has been verified; HTTP/error fallback still needs a recorded test.
bugs.evidence: LIVE-DATA-001 run #18 returned Gemini VERIFY with no API key while all numerical/source checks remained healthy.
bugs.next_action: Add GEMINI_API_KEY as a GitHub Actions secret and separately test an intentional API failure.

bugs.title: GitHub Pages observability deployment not yet verified
bugs.description: The docs dashboard exists, but the public Pages deployment still needs visual confirmation.
bugs.next_action: Enable main:/docs in GitHub Pages and confirm the page loads on phone/desktop.

bugs.title: GitHub-hosted runner received HTTP 451 from api.binance.com
bugs.description: The first health run could not reach the primary Binance API hostname from the runner region.
bugs.evidence: LIVE-DATA-001 run #1 failed with HTTP 451; official market-data-only fallback data-api.binance.vision was added.
bugs.verification: Subsequent live runs PASS; run #18 reports base_url_used=data-api.binance.vision.
bugs.next_action: Keep all Binance bases observable in health evidence.

bugs.title: Resolution code used the candle opened at 12:00 instead of the 1m candle closing at 12:00 ET
bugs.description: Live market rules explicitly say the Binance one-minute candle closes at 12:00 ET. The corresponding candle opens at 11:59 ET.
bugs.evidence: Resolution code changed to CLOSE_AT semantics. LIVE-DATA-001 run #18 replayed 2026-10-06 with expected and actual open/close millisecond timestamps equal.
bugs.verification: Historical exact-timestamp replay PASS plus unit resolution test PASS in CI run #25.
bugs.next_action: Keep candle_reference=CLOSE_AT in config and rules verification.

bugs.title: Open-ended Polymarket range tails were dropped by the parser
bugs.description: The original parser only accepted two-number brackets and omitted the lower and upper open-ended tails, making probability coverage incomplete.
bugs.evidence: Parser now supports lower=None / upper=None tails. LIVE-DATA-001 run #18 discovered 11 total brackets: 9 finite + lower tail + upper tail.
bugs.verification: Range coverage PASS in live health and parser unit tests PASS in CI run #25.
bugs.next_action: Treat missing either tail as FAIL in LIVE-DATA health.
